Trishakti Power Generation Corporation 
 PSU CLIENT · West Bengal · IN 
 
 REFERENCE LETTER 
 
 To Whomsoever It May Concern 
 
 Ref: REF/25/103 Date: 31/03/2026 
 To Whomsoever It May Concern, 
 
 This letter is issued at the request of National Infrastructure Corp. Ltd. to confirm that the said
 agency has executed work for this organisation as detailed below and that their performance has been
 found satisfactory. 
 1. PROJECT DETAILS 
 
 
 Project Name Six-Lane Highway - West Bengal Pkg-116 
 Scope of Work Expressways works for Trishakti Power Generation Corporation
 completed 2020. 
 
 Nature of Work Expressways 
 Contract Value Rs. 20000.00 Lakh 
 
 Date of Completion 2020-02-11 
 
 Contractor's Role Prime 
 
 2. PERFORMANCE ASSESSMENT 
 Throughout the engagement the agency's conduct was professional, though correspondence on
 variations was occasionally slow, and . On that basis the agency has been placed on our approved-
 agency list for this class of work. 
 
 Criterion Rating Observation 
 
 Adherence to Schedule Excellent Project delivered within contractual timeline
 Quality of Work Excellent Workmanship meets or exceeds specifications 
 
 Safety Record Good BOCW Act compliance maintained throughout 
 
 Responsiveness Excellent Prompt resolution of site issues and RFIs 
 Financial Integrity Good Billing was accurate and supported by records
 
 3. RECOMMENDATION 
 
 We confirm that National Infrastructure Corp. Ltd. executed the referenced work to our satisfaction.
 Their performance on schedule, quality, and safety was commendable. 
 We have no hesitation in recommending National Infrastructure Corp. Ltd. for similar assignments in
 the future. This reference is valid for a period of Medium from the date of this letter.
 
 4. VERIFICATION 
 
 For any verification or further information, please contact the undersigned at +91-9830000000 or ee@dept.gov.in. This letter
 is issued upon specific request of the contractor and does not constitute any commitment or guarantee for future
 engagements.
